name: PR list FINDINGS column shows severity chips and a hover dropdown
description: On the seeded repo's PR list, PR #501 ('Cache pricing tiers in Redis…') has a completed run, so its FINDINGS cell renders severity chips (2 CRITICAL / 3 WARNING / 1 SUGGESTION) behind an aria-label='6 findings' button. Hovering the cell lazy-fetches GET /pulls/:id/reviews and opens the [role=tooltip] dropdown (header '6 findings') listing each finding's title + file:line. PR #482 has a review but no completed run, so its findings cell stays a muted em-dash — asserted as best-effort via the em-dash's presence on the list (the runner can't scope to a non-<tr> row). Read-only seeded data (no model call); assumes the freshly-seeded hermetic DB (see e2e/README.md). Covers PRFindingsCell + FindingsHoverCard.
